answers.name: Qwen 3.6 Reference-based - No Reasoning Baseline
answers.org: WMT Automated MT Evaluation Organizing Committee
answers.reference_usage: Our system uses all three reference types (native/human, postedit, and pseudo) where available, with the reference type determined per language pair from the shared task data. The reference translation is included in both stages of our two-stage GEMBA-ESA prompting pipeline: in Stage 1, the model is shown the source, MT hypothesis, and reference together when annotating error spans; in Stage 2, the reference is again provided alongside the source, hypothesis, and Stage 1 error annotations when assigning the final quality score. The prompt labels the reference according to its type ("Human reference translation," "Post-edited reference translation," or "High-quality machine translation reference") so the model can appropriately weight it. For language pairs where no reference is available, the system falls back to the reference-free prompt variant.
